name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
short: DeepSeek's MIT 552B multimodal MoE (1M context, 384K out) for long-context agentic workloads; Terminal-Bench 90.6% and GPQA 90.9%.
standout: The long-context open-weight workhorse: multimodal, 1M-in/384K-out and terminal-grade coding under an MIT license.
tradeoff: Flash-class tuning gives away some peak reasoning depth; the V4 Pro flagship is the one for hardest problems.
notable: Cybersecurity: CyberGym 88.1% is the field-leading defensive vulnerability-discovery figure in DeepSeek's own comparison panel (ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol and GLM-5.3 at 84.5%), corroborated across the folder's reports; offensive exploit generation is the weak side (ExploitGym 15.3%).
